Container.Name: seadex-scout
Container.Overview:
Keeps your Sonarr and Radarr anime library in sync with the best releases on SeaDex, the community list of the best release for each show.
Tells you when SeaDex lists a better release than yours, or a newer v2 or REPACK of it, and writes an on-demand report comparing each season you have with SeaDex. It leaves downloads to Sonarr and Radarr. It can also offer SeaDex's picks to them as a Torznab indexer, so they download under your quality rules.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: seadex anime sonarr radarr releases.moe torznab
Container.Requires:
Sonarr URL and Sonarr API key are enough to start. Fill them in and the first start writes /config/config.yaml, reads your values from these fields and begins comparing. Leave Radarr empty if you only run Sonarr.
A finding is a warning line in the container log, never a download. Read the log from the Docker tab.
For a full season-by-season report, run this from an Unraid terminal (Tools, then Terminal) while the container is up: docker exec seadex-scout /seadex-scout report It writes a timestamped Markdown and JSON pair into /config/reports. The container is distroless, so the Console button in the Docker tab does not work.
Everything else is tuned in /config/config.yaml, which is annotated. The container reads it once at start, so restart it after an edit.
The Torznab port is only bound when a Torznab URL is set in config.yaml. Leave the port mapping alone otherwise. Keep that feed on your LAN, because its AnimeBytes links carry your passkey.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Where seadex-scout reaches Sonarr, including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:8989. Use the server's LAN IP, not a container name

Config.Name: Sonarr API key
Config.Description: Sonarr's API key, from Settings, then General, then API Key in Sonarr

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.yaml, state and the reports folder

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Where seadex-scout reaches Radarr, for example http://192.0.2.100:7878. Leave empty to watch Sonarr only

Config.Name: Radarr API key
Config.Description: Radarr's API key, from Settings, then General, then API Key in Radarr. Required when Radarr URL is set

Config.Name: Torznab port
Config.Description: Torznab feed for Sonarr, Radarr or Prowlarr. It listens only when a Torznab URL is configured in config.yaml
